mit_gain_profile.name: mit_kp6_kd025_v1
mit_gain_profile.gain_semantics: candidate effective normalized MIT gains; not hardware readback

ts20_protocol.gain_selection: b+Kd exceeds 1.4 times maximum negative Stribeck friction slope; fixed before new flights

motion_model.coordinate: MIT-reported rotor angle divided by signed gear; independent output-shaft angle not established
motion_model.scale: command normalized ka=1 convention; J_total_over_ka is not identified physical body inertia
motion_model.identified_assembly: fixed PLA bench with original small PLA output disk; attachment/body inertias not separated
motion_model.identification_supply: 20 V nominal, 2 A supply limit; not an Iq limit
motion_model.input_contract: actual quantized MIT q_ref,dq_ref,tau_ff and fixed gains; delayed ZOH external forcing, continuous model-internal PD
motion_model.initialization: first state only; unknown first-command prehistory held constant
limitations: No unique physical Kt, inertia split, gear stiffness, backlash width, or internal three-loop reconstruction.
Current frozen parameters were transferred across recorded gains and motions; finite historical validation is not global stability or TS20-100 qualification.
Additional known inertia cannot be added directly to J_total_over_ka without the unknown physical scale ka.
Blocked-output geometry and backlash are not represented by this free-motion model.

joint_command_audit.law: qd_cmd = clip(qd_reference + 3*(q_reference - ROS measured q), +/-0.15 rad/s)
joint_command_audit.semantics: Command-law audit only; main tracking metrics use independent native physics states

native_tip_geometry.semantics: Independent native distal-link WorldPose tip versus +Y-axis FK of same-step base pose/q; no phase or offset fit

result.scope: Original small joint-direction/tracking/body-stability envelope; no claim of external-force rejection or whole-body endpoint compensation

protocol.worker_startup_gc: explicit full collection after construction before READY and parameter transaction; automatic GC remains enabled with unchanged thresholds during control
protocol.cpu_scope: owned simulation processes only; SMT siblings excluded from owned background workloads; ordinary scheduler; host not reserved; Orin requires its own measurement
protocol.source_evidence: separate nonblocking recorder; no retained message/feedback graphs; natural GC unchanged
protocol.model_cadence_clock: first admission waits 20 ms actual simulation time; subsequent admission uses a one-shot actual-send release and a strictly newer real source; model dt is always the measured source difference, not forced to 20 ms
protocol.transport_deadline_clock: same-host monotonic wall clock; unchanged thresholds
protocol.next_solve_commit: one next solve after matching actual writer send; retain send barrier, single pending candidate and original source times; no additional independent 20 ms physical minimum after the first solve
protocol.incomplete_run_policy: retain raw evidence, no certificate, do not advance to next stage
protocol.numerical_convergence: QP aggregate plus per-original-row 1e-10 numerical target; original 2e-7 external feasibility, weights and physical constraints unchanged
protocol.ground_initialization: construct cached lifecycle allocator and start idle transport on disarmed ground; actual LiveStart binds live reference/history after normal prestream
protocol.transport_lifecycle: READY has no actuator output or active-output deadline; actual LiveStart starts consumption freshness supervision with backlog resynchronization; first accepted candidate starts dispatcher output deadlines; active faults remain latched and original thresholds unchanged
protocol.native_preparation: native-only packed future MIT arrays and matrix rows; actual candidate propagation and all extrema retained; same C++ physical libraries and independent reference predictor; new source-bound full regression/30 matrix/388 historical qualification
protocol.live_diagnostic_snapshot: private zero-FF live policy: candidate quality and actual command checked before publication; complete FF diagnostics and owned copy finish after publication and before synchronous immutable pickle or any next solve; completion failure locks worker and retains explicit incomplete-recording evidence
protocol.execution_timing_evidence: bounded in-memory stage timestamps written after shutdown; distinguish engine return, proposal publication, gate entry and diagnostic serialization; original DDS schemas and timestamps retained
protocol.source_callback_dispatch: active main executor always nonblocking with unchanged wait arguments; separate depth-one fault executor polled before main work; full-depth original evidence retained
protocol.fault_supervision: independent ROS node/executor; matching session and epoch; first fault latched with local callback observation time; complete evidence remains separate
protocol.history_timestamp_consistency: C++ command/packet future comparisons use the existing Python 1e-10 second task-relative arithmetic tolerance; source clocks, wall leases, dt limits and original timestamps unchanged
protocol.rejected_input_evidence: first rejected admission retained in bounded memory with original source identity; exact gate-input CDR and clocks written only at shutdown
protocol.failed_recovery_handoff: failed runs release and verify the sole C++ writer and zero consumption, then require new PX4 ACK and fresh autonomous-Hold status within 350ms before folding; otherwise skip fold and use original LAND; unverified writer exit retains receive-only pumping with no legacy joint publisher; no hardware qualification

execution_resources.scope: owned simulation processes only; SMT siblings excluded from owned background workloads; ordinary scheduler; host not reserved; Orin requires its own measurement
